I'm your host, Darren Van Dam!

April 2026 doesn't just bring one of the best free movie lineups I've ever seen on Tubi, April also features the most top-notch hidden gem movies I've ever seen Tubi add all at once. This movie list focuses on those rare finds that always seem to elude streaming services, even the paid ones like Netflix, with Ransom, Heist, Black Dynamite and the Nordic thriller Headhunters.

Beyond all these underrated and hidden gem movies Tubi also added some massive blockbusters like the Rock and Saving Private Ryan. I highly recommend checking out Tubi's recently added section to see the full lineup of recently added movies. Don't forget to check my list recap for a full list of all the streaming services currently hosting these titles other than Tubi.

Thanks for watching!
